title: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and werewolf from Kessig on Innistrad who relives her first hunts with Tovolar, loses her wolves to his pack, and asks her friends for help.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Arlinn's old mentor in the ways of the wolf, a huge werewolf who is gathering a new pack and wants to take the nights as well as the woods.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: An ancient witch who leads a coven in the Kessig woods and needs the Moonsilver key for a ritual.

entities.name: Streak
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, who goes to Tovolar's side.

entities.name: Boulder
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, who jumps in front of Tovolar and sides with him.

entities.name: Patience
entities.description: Arlinn's wolf, who stays at her side longest before Arlinn sends her to Tovolar.

entities.name: Redtooth
entities.description: One of Arlinn's wolves, who joins Tovolar's pack.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: An almost unfathomably old planeswalker who greets Arlinn warmly at Jace's house on Ravnica and agrees to help.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker who joins Arlinn in Kessig.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who is upset by day and night falling out of balance and agrees to help.

entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: A cathar in white armor who leads the gathered cathars and Kessigers and agrees to go to Thraben.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker whose house on Ravnica Arlinn visits; he is not there.

entities.name: Luciana
entities.description: A baker's daughter and friend of Arlinn at the church, who checks on her the night Arlinn changes.

entities.name: Barnaby
entities.description: A friend of Arlinn from the church who teased her about being first into the cathedral.

entities.name: Father Zakarias
entities.description: A priest at the church who gently asked Arlinn whether she had anything to confess.

entities.name: Dires
entities.description: Huge wolves with arms thick as trees who stand beside Tovolar and enjoy making vampires beg.

entities.name: Mondronen Howlpack
entities.description: Tovolar's old pack, whose salute greets him as he gathers a new one.

entities.name: Dawnheart Coven
entities.description: The coven from which the Moonsilver key was taken centuries ago.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel whose holy symbols the people of Kessig keep in their homes and churches.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Arlinn is from, whose nights are growing longer.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: The wooded region of Innistrad where Arlinn grew up and the wolves hunt.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where Arlinn goes to find Jace's house and her friends.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The city on Innistrad whose cathedral vaults may hold the Moonsilver key.

entities.name: The Celestus
entities.description: An ancient artifact whose pieces arc over the woods and whose center is the site of the ritual.

entities.name: Moonsilver key
entities.description: A key taken from the Dawnheart Coven centuries ago that must be joined with the Sungold lock to complete the ritual.

entities.name: Sungold lock
entities.description: The lock that joins with the Moonsilver key at the center of the Celestus.

entities.name: Harvesttide
entities.description: A festival that Katilda considers necessary to the ritual.

events.summary: In a flashback Arlinn, after her first change, sits with Tovolar, who tells her the woods belong to them; she suggests they could share them with the Kessigers.
events.quote: "These woods belong to us," he told her.

events.summary: Arlinn shifts into a wolf and runs after Tovolar and her wolves, answering his howl.
events.quote: She shifts before she knows what she's doing

events.summary: Arlinn remembers hearing Tovolar's howl as a girl and leaving her walled-in village at night for a life without fear.
events.quote: Under cover of night, she left.

events.summary: Arlinn finds Tovolar surrounded by huge wolves who have changed early, and asks who the newcomers are.
events.quote: "Who are these guys?"

events.summary: In a flashback Tovolar shows young Arlinn three torn-apart hunters and tells her that being free is worth whatever it costs.
events.quote: "Being free is worth whatever we pay for it," he answered.

events.summary: Arlinn sees that the wolves gathered around Tovolar are a new pack, not his old Mondronen one, and that something bigger than a hunt is being prepared.
events.quote: "Family," he answers. "Our new pack."

events.summary: Tovolar reveals he is getting ready to take the nights as well as the woods, hunting vampires and anyone else.
events.quote: "Getting ready to take what's ours," he says.

events.summary: Arlinn refuses to accept that wolves can do whatever they want, and Tovolar scorns her for having too much church in her.
events.quote: "Too much church in you," he growls. "Too little wolf."

events.summary: In a flashback Arlinn comes home to her mother, who says four boys were found torn apart in the woods, and Arlinn cannot bring herself to tell the truth.
events.quote: "Where were you?" she creaked.

events.summary: In a flashback Arlinn wakes after a hunt with a bolt-wound healed and the bodies of the village kids, now hunters, around her, and screams.
events.quote: Her mouth was slick with their blood.

events.summary: Arlinn raises a claw to strike Tovolar to delay his plans, but Boulder jumps in front of him and she pulls back.
events.quote: But before it can make contact, Boulder's in motion, jumping in front of him.

events.summary: Streak, Redtooth and Boulder side with Tovolar, and Arlinn sees that her wolves want to hunt.
events.quote: Streak joins him. So does Redtooth.

events.summary: In a flashback Arlinn finds refuge in the church, where friends help her feel safe, until Tovolar comes to morning services and sits beside her.
events.quote: Until he showed up to morning services.

events.summary: Arlinn locks herself in her room with holy symbols, but it is not enough, and she wakes elsewhere with the memory of blood.
events.quote: Arlinn locked herself in her room that night

events.summary: Arlinn sends Patience to join Tovolar so she can stay with the wolves and keep them safe.
events.quote: "Keep everyone safe," she says.

events.summary: Tovolar invites Arlinn to find him when she is ready for the new world and begins to shift; she leaves.
events.quote: Tovolar nods. "When you're ready for the new world, come find us."

events.summary: Arlinn returns to Katilda and agrees to get the key; Katilda welcomes her to the fire without remarking on the missing wolves.
events.quote: "I'll get your key," she says.

events.summary: At first light Katilda and her witches cast a calling for the coven's chosen champions while Arlinn sneaks off to Ravnica to find help.
events.quote: she sneaks off to Ravnica.

events.summary: Arlinn finds Jace absent from his house but is greeted by Teferi, who guesses she has not slept.
events.quote: "Take it you didn't just come here to keep me company, Arlinn," he says.

events.summary: Arlinn tells Teferi the nights on Innistrad are growing longer and something is coming, and Chandra leaps down the stairs to greet her.
events.quote: "The nights on Innistrad are getting longer, but that means no one's getting any rest."

events.summary: Kaya joins them with a joke about pencil on ink-only forms, and Arlinn laughs for the first time.
events.quote: "So, you're the one who used pencil on the ink-only forms?"

events.summary: Kaya, Teferi and Chandra agree to help and travel with Arlinn to Katilda's coven in the Kessig woods.
events.quote: They'll come. They'll help.

events.summary: Arlinn introduces her friends to Adeline and the assembled cathars, priests and Kessigers.
events.quote: "Adeline's fine.

events.summary: Katilda explains that the Moonsilver key must be brought to the center of the Celestus to be joined with the Sungold lock, and that its whereabouts are unknown.
events.quote: "You bring it to the center of the Celestus.

events.summary: Arlinn suggests the church in Thraben may have taken the key, and the group decides to go there.
events.quote: She nods. "To Thraben, then."

relations.note: Tovolar guided Arlinn through her first hunts.
relations.quote: On the first hunt, she ran with Tovolar.

relations.note: She tries to strike him down to stop his plan for the pack.
Arlinn's wolf goes to Tovolar's side.
relations.quote: Streak joins him. So does Redtooth.
Arlinn stands, and Patience walks to him.
"Take it you didn't just come here to keep me company, Arlinn," he says.

relations.note: Chandra is a friend who comes to help.
relations.quote: "Arlinn!" she calls, plopping herself down at one of the tables next to them.

relations.note: Kaya agrees to help find the key.
Arlinn promises to get Katilda's key.
Kessig is a region of Innistrad.
relations.quote: "The nights on Innistrad are getting longer, but that means no one's getting any rest.
